name: Two-Control Directed-Cycle Family
definition: For every even $m\geq4$, let $G_m$ be the consistently directed cycle of length $m$ and set $D_m=C_2(G_m)$.
properties: The class has $m+2$ coordinates, $4m+4$ concepts, VC dimension two, and empty separator coefficient space. It is dismantlable ample and finite convex-treelike, admits a union-closed well-graded orientation, and every proper nonempty pc-minor is convex-realizable. The family is an infinite pc-minor antichain. The first member $D_4$ has 20 concepts on six coordinates.
